import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/data2/_shared/runs/ft_rounds');writer=pathlib.Path('/data2/FreeToken/scripts/round_json_append.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(writer.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='67c36b2fe91400372e3e470caa443afeefde8ac53bb7aff515e32d407a4d48ff'
out=[]
for rid in ('E2-R000','E2-R008','E2-pre-gate-D01'):
 d=root/rid;p=d/'round.json';m=d/'MANIFEST.sha256';x=json.loads(p.read_bytes())
 r=subprocess.run(['sha256sum','-c',str(m)],cwd=d,capture_output=True);h=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(writer),str(d),'check'],capture_output=True)
 assert r.returncode==h.returncode==0 and x['verdict']=='kept'
 assert not any(v.stat().st_mode&0o222 for v in (d,*d.rglob('*')))
 out.append({'rid':rid,'verdict':x['verdict'],'round_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(m.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'manifest_check':r.returncode,'history_check':h.returncode,'read_only':True})
print(json.dumps(out))
